headline: Colombia Central Bank Holds Interest Rate at 12.25%
summary: Colombia's central bank board voted by majority to keep the benchmark interest rate unchanged at 12.25%. Annual inflation in September ticked up slightly to 6.3%, slightly below market expectations.
why: Central bank policy rates dictate borrowing costs and influence foreign exchange rates and domestic credit conditions.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: The monetary policy decision directly sets the benchmark borrowing costs for Colombia.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Maintaining the policy rate signals the central bank's ongoing cautious stance amid persistent inflation readings.
